## 本节考纲要求

本页依据 9709 Mathematics 2026–2027 syllabus 3.3，覆盖：

- secant、cosecant、cotangent 的定义、定义域、值域与图像；
- 任意角度下六个三角函数的性质；
- 使用 $\sec^2\theta=1+\tan^2\theta$ 与 $\operatorname{cosec}^2\theta=1+\cot^2\theta$；
- compound-angle formulae、double-angle formulae，以及三角恒等式的证明、化简和 exact evaluation；
- 解含有三角函数的 equations；
- 将 $a\sin\theta+b\cos\theta$ 写成 $R\sin(\theta\pm\alpha)$ 或 $R\cos(\theta\pm\alpha)$。
:::

## Learning objectives

::: {.study-card}

- [ ] 能写出 sec、cosec、cot 与 sin、cos、tan 的 reciprocal relationships
- [ ] 能识别 $y=\sec x$、$y=\operatorname{cosec}x$、$y=\cot x$ 的 asymptotes、period 和 range
- [ ] 能熟练使用 reciprocal identities 与 compound/double-angle formulae
- [ ] 能把三角方程化为关于 $\sin\theta$、$\cos\theta$ 或 $\tan\theta$ 的 quadratic
- [ ] 能准确处理题目给出的 degree / radian interval，并检查所有 roots
- [ ] 能完成 $R$-form conversion，并用它求三角表达式的最大值、最小值或方程的解

:::

## 1. Six trigonometric functions

::: {.study-card}
### Definitions and reciprocal relationships

除了 $\sin x$、$\cos x$、$\tan x$，还要掌握：

$$
\sec x=\frac1{\cos x},\qquad
\operatorname{cosec}x=\frac1{\sin x},\qquad
\cot x=\frac1{\tan x}=\frac{\cos x}{\sin x}.
$$

因此：

$$
\tan^2x+1=\sec^2x,
\qquad
1+\cot^2x=\operatorname{cosec}^2x.
$$

使用这些式子时，要同时注意原始函数的定义域：$\sec x$ 在 $\cos x=0$ 时不存在，$\operatorname{cosec}x$ 和 $\cot x$ 在 $\sin x=0$ 时不存在。
:::

::: {.worked-example}
<span class="we-tag">Worked example · 笔记第 3 页</span>

![Reciprocal trigonometric functions](../assets/notes/trigonometry/worked-example-01.webp){.note-figure fig-alt="Worked example proving a reciprocal trigonometric identity and solving it"}

这个例子展示了一个常见套路：先把 tan、cot 都改写成 sin、cos，约去共同因子，再在原区间内列出全部解。
:::

::: {.study-card}
### Graph facts to remember

三种 reciprocal graphs 的关键性质如下。所有周期均按输入变量计算：

| Function | Period | Vertical asymptotes | Range |
|---|---:|---|---|
| $y=\sec x$ | $2\pi$ | $x=\frac\pi2+k\pi$ | $y\le -1$ 或 $y\ge1$ |
| $y=\operatorname{cosec}x$ | $2\pi$ | $x=k\pi$ | $y\le -1$ 或 $y\ge1$ |
| $y=\cot x$ | $\pi$ | $x=k\pi$ | all real numbers |

其中 $k\in\mathbb Z$。图像题要标出 asymptotes，不能把 reciprocal graph 画成平滑地穿过 asymptote 的曲线。
:::

<span class="we-tag">Worked example · 笔记第 7 页</span>

![Secant graph transformation](../assets/notes/trigonometry/worked-example-02.webp){.note-figure fig-alt="Worked example sketching a transformed secant graph and finding a range"}
:::

## 2. Reciprocal identities and equations

::: {.study-card}
### Choosing the right substitution

看到 sec、cosec 或 cot 的高次式时，先用 reciprocal identities 把题目变成一个变量的 quadratic：

$$
\sec^2\theta=1+\tan^2\theta,
\qquad
\operatorname{cosec}^2\theta=1+\cot^2\theta.
$$

例如，若出现 $9\sec^2\theta-11=3\tan\theta$，令 $t=\tan\theta$，则

$$
9(1+t^2)-11=3t
\quad\Longrightarrow\quad
9t^2-3t-2=0.
$$

解出 $t$ 后，再根据给定区间和 tangent 的周期补齐 $\theta$。
:::

<span class="we-tag">Worked example · 笔记第 10 页</span>

## 3. Compound-angle formulae

::: {.study-card}
### Addition and subtraction formulae

必须熟练掌握：

$$
\sin(A\pm B)=\sin A\cos B\pm\cos A\sin B,
$$

$$
\cos(A\pm B)=\cos A\cos B\mp\sin A\sin B,
$$

$$
\tan(A\pm B)=\frac{\tan A\pm\tan B}{1\mp\tan A\tan B}.
$$

解 compound-angle equation 时，先确定 calculator 的 angle mode，再用 principal value 和 periodicity 找全区间解。不要把 $\tan^{-1}$ 的一个 principal value 当成唯一答案。
:::

::: {.worked-example}
<span class="we-tag">Worked example · 笔记第 12 页</span>

![Tangent subtraction formula](../assets/notes/trigonometry/worked-example-04.webp){.note-figure fig-alt="Worked example applying the tangent subtraction formula"}
:::

## 4. Double-angle formulae

::: {.study-card}
### The forms that are most useful in Paper 3

$$
\sin2A=2\sin A\cos A,
$$

$$
\cos2A=\cos^2A-\sin^2A=2\cos^2A-1=1-2\sin^2A,
$$

$$
\tan2A=\frac{2\tan A}{1-\tan^2A}.
$$

选择哪一种 $\cos2A$ form，取决于题目希望最后得到 $\sin A$、$\cos A$ 还是一个 quadratic。若要 factorise，先用 $\sin2A=2\sin A\cos A$ 往往最直接。
:::

## 5. R-form conversion

::: {.formula-panel}
### Converting a sine-cosine combination

若要写成

$$
a\sin\theta+b\cos\theta=R\sin(\theta+\alpha),
$$

展开右边并比较系数：

$$
R\cos\alpha=a,\qquad R\sin\alpha=b,
$$

所以

$$
R=\sqrt{a^2+b^2},\qquad \tan\alpha=\frac ba.
$$

同理，

$$
a\cos\theta+b\sin\theta=R\cos(\theta-\alpha),
$$

其中 $R\cos\alpha=a$、$R\sin\alpha=b$。
:::

::: {.worked-example}
<span class="we-tag">Worked example · 笔记第 19 页</span>

![R-form sine expression](../assets/notes/trigonometry/worked-example-06.webp){.note-figure fig-alt="Worked example converting a sine and cosine combination into R sine form"}

转换后，$R\sin(\theta+\alpha)$ 的 range 是 $[-R,R]$。这可以直接回答 maximum/minimum questions，也能把 equation 化为一个 standard sine equation。
:::

## 6. Paper 3 past-paper questions

本节精选 **20 道** 2020–2024 Paper 3 中与 Trigonometry 直接相关的题目。题目保留原题的数学条件、区间和精度要求；答案按 matching mark scheme 展开，并在容易丢分处补充 domain、periodicity 和 invalid roots 的检查。

### Compound angles and R-form

::: {.question-card #trig-2020-mj31-q3}
### Example 1 · Compound-angle equation · 9709/31/M/J/20 Q3
<span class="tag">tan addition</span><span class="tag">quadratic</span>

Express the equation $\tan(\theta+60^\circ)=2+\tan(60^\circ-\theta)$ as a quadratic equation in $\tan\theta$, and hence solve the equation for $0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$. **[6]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

令 $t=\tan\theta$。由 compound-angle formula，

$$
\tan(\theta+60^\circ)=\frac{t+\sqrt3}{1-\sqrt3t},
\qquad
\tan(60^\circ-\theta)=\frac{\sqrt3-t}{1+\sqrt3t}.
$$

代回原式并通分，化简得到

$$
3t^2+4t-1=0.
$$

所以

$$
t=\frac{-2\pm\sqrt7}{3}.
$$

分别取 tangent 的反函数并按区间补解：

$$
\theta=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{-2+\sqrt7}{3}\right)=12.147...^\circ,
$$

$$
\theta=180^\circ+\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{-2-\sqrt7}{3}\right)=122.852...^\circ.
$$

因此 $\boxed{\theta=12.1^\circ,\ 122.9^\circ}$。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2020-mj31-q3"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2020/2020/9709-s20-qp-31.pdf` and matching `9709-s20-ms-31.pdf`.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2020-mj32-q5}
### Example 2 · R-form and equation · 9709/32/M/J/20 Q5
<span class="tag">R-form</span><span class="tag">degrees</span>

(a) Express $2\cos x-5\sin x$ in the form $R\cos(x+\phi)$, where $R>0$ and $0^\circ<\phi<90^\circ$. Give the exact value of $R$ and the value of $\phi$ correct to 3 decimal places.

(b) Hence solve the equation $2\cos2\theta-5\sin2\theta=1$, for $0^\circ<\theta<180^\circ$. **[7]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

(a) 展开

$$
R\cos(x+\phi)=R\cos\phi\cos x-R\sin\phi\sin x.
$$

比较系数：$R\cos\phi=2$、$R\sin\phi=5$。因此

$$
R=\sqrt{2^2+5^2}=\sqrt{29},
\qquad
\tan\phi=\frac52,
$$

so $\boxed{R=\sqrt{29},\ \phi=68.199^\circ}$。

(b) 令 $u=2\theta$，方程变为

$$
\sqrt{29}\cos(u+\phi)=1.
$$

令 $\beta=\cos^{-1}(1/\sqrt{29})=79.298...^\circ$。由于 $0^\circ<u<360^\circ$，

$$
u+\phi=\beta\quad\text{or}\quad u+\phi=360^\circ-\beta.
$$

因此

$$
\theta=\frac{\beta-\phi}{2}=5.550...^\circ,
\qquad
\theta=\frac{360^\circ-\beta-\phi}{2}=106.252...^\circ.
$$

答案为 $\boxed{\theta=5.55^\circ,\ 106.25^\circ}$。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2020-mj32-q5"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2020/2020/9709-s20-qp-32.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2020-on31-q6}
### Example 3 · R-form and restricted interval · 9709/31/O/N/20 Q6
<span class="tag">R-form</span><span class="tag">interval</span>

(a) Express $6\cos x+3\sin x$ in the form $R\cos(x-\phi)$, where $R>0$ and $0^\circ<\phi<90^\circ$. State the exact value of $R$ and give $\phi$ correct to 2 decimal places.

(b) Hence solve the equation $6\cos\frac{x}{3}+3\sin\frac{x}{3}=2.5$, for $0^\circ<x<360^\circ$. **[7]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

(a) 比较

$$
R\cos(x-\phi)=R\cos\phi\cos x+R\sin\phi\sin x.
$$

故 $R\cos\phi=6$、$R\sin\phi=3$，从而

$$
\boxed{R=3\sqrt5},
\qquad
\boxed{\phi=\tan^{-1}(1/2)=26.57^\circ}.
$$

(b) 令 $u=x/3$，则 $0^\circ<u<120^\circ$，且

$$
3\sqrt5\cos(u-\phi)=2.5.
$$

令 $\beta=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{2.5}{3\sqrt5}\right)=68.119...^\circ$。候选值为 $u=\phi\pm\beta$，但 $\phi-\beta<0^\circ$ 不在区间内，只有

$$
u=\phi+\beta=94.684...^\circ.
$$

所以 $\boxed{x=3u=284.1^\circ}$。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2020-on31-q6"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2020/2020/9709_w20_qp_31.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2020-on32-q4}
### Example 4 · Tangent addition equation · 9709/32/O/N/20 Q4
<span class="tag">tan addition</span><span class="tag">quadratic</span>

(a) Show that the equation $\tan(\theta+60^\circ)=2\cot\theta$ can be written in the form

$$
\tan^2\theta+3\sqrt3\tan\theta-2=0.
$$

(b) Hence solve the equation $\tan(\theta+60^\circ)=2\cot\theta$, for $0^\circ<\theta<180^\circ$. **[6]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

令 $t=\tan\theta$。则

$$
\frac{t+\sqrt3}{1-\sqrt3t}=\frac2t.
$$

交叉相乘：

$$
t(t+\sqrt3)=2(1-\sqrt3t)
\Longrightarrow
t^2+3\sqrt3t-2=0.
$$

所以

$$
t=\frac{-3\sqrt3\pm\sqrt{35}}2.
$$

两个根分别给出

$$
\theta=\tan^{-1}(0.3599...)=19.797...^\circ,
$$

以及第三象限对应的

$$
\theta=180^\circ+\tan^{-1}(-5.556...)=100.203...^\circ.
$$

因此 $\boxed{\theta=19.8^\circ,\ 100.2^\circ}$。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2020-on32-q4"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2020/2020/9709_w20_qp_32.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2021-on31-q2}
### Example 5 · Maximum and minimum · 9709/31/O/N/21 Q2
<span class="tag">R-form</span><span class="tag">range</span>

(a) Express $5\sin x-3\cos x$ in the form $R\sin(x-\phi)$, where $R>0$ and $0<\phi<\frac12\pi$. Give the exact value of $R$ and the value of $\phi$ correct to 2 decimal places.

(b) Hence state the greatest and least possible values of $(5\sin x-3\cos x)^2$. **[5]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

由

$$
R\sin(x-\phi)=R\cos\phi\sin x-R\sin\phi\cos x,
$$

比较系数得 $R\cos\phi=5$、$R\sin\phi=3$。所以

$$
R=\sqrt{34},\qquad \phi=\tan^{-1}(3/5)=30.96^\circ.
$$

故 $5\sin x-3\cos x$ 的 range 是 $[-\sqrt{34},\sqrt{34}]$。平方后

$$
0\le(5\sin x-3\cos x)^2\le34.
$$

因此 least value 为 $\boxed0$，greatest value 为 $\boxed{34}$。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2021-on31-q2"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2021/2021/9709_w21_qp_31.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2021-on33-q5}
### Example 6 · Double-angle substitution · 9709/33/O/N/21 Q5
<span class="tag">double angle</span><span class="tag">quadratic</span>

Solve the equation $\sin\theta=3\cos2\theta+2$, for $0^\circ\le\theta\le360^\circ$. **[5]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

令 $s=\sin\theta$，并使用 $\cos2\theta=1-2\sin^2\theta$：

$$
s=3(1-2s^2)+2
\Longrightarrow
6s^2+s-5=0.
$$

因式分解：

$$
(6s-5)(s+1)=0.
$$

所以 $s=5/6$ 或 $s=-1$。在 $0^\circ\le\theta\le360^\circ$ 内，

$$
\sin\theta=\frac56
\Longrightarrow
\theta=\sin^{-1}(5/6)=56.443^\circ
$$

或 $180^\circ-56.443^\circ=123.557^\circ$；而 $\sin\theta=-1$ 给出 $\theta=270^\circ$。

答案为 $\boxed{\theta=56.4^\circ,\ 123.6^\circ,\ 270^\circ}$。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2021-on33-q5"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2021/2021/9709_w21_qp_33.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2021-mj33-q5}
### Example 7 · Double-angle tangent identity · 9709/33/M/J/21 Q5
<span class="tag">double angle</span><span class="tag">tan</span>

(a) By first expanding $\tan(2\theta+2\theta)$, show that the equation $\tan4\theta=\frac12\tan\theta$ may be expressed as

$$
\tan^4\theta+2\tan^2\theta-7=0.
$$

(b) Hence solve the equation $\tan4\theta=\frac12\tan\theta$, for $0^\circ<\theta<180^\circ$. **[7]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

令 $t=\tan\theta$。先令 $u=\tan2\theta=2t/(1-t^2)$，再使用 $\tan4\theta=2u/(1-u^2)$，得到

$$
\tan4\theta=\frac{4t(1-t^2)}{1-6t^2+t^4}.
$$

代入 $\tan4\theta=\frac12t$，并整理：

$$
\frac{4t(1-t^2)}{1-6t^2+t^4}=\frac12t
\Longrightarrow
8(1-t^2)=1-6t^2+t^4,
$$

所以

$$
t^4+2t^2-7=0.
$$

令 $v=t^2$，则 $v^2+2v-7=0$，故

$$
t^2=-1+2\sqrt2
$$

（另一个根为负，不可作为 $t^2$）。因此 $t=\pm\sqrt{-1+2\sqrt2}$。

在给定区间内，两个 tangent roots 给出

$$
\theta=\tan^{-1}\!\sqrt{-1+2\sqrt2}=53.516^\circ,
$$

以及第二象限的 $180^\circ-53.516^\circ=126.484^\circ$。

答案为 $\boxed{\theta=53.5^\circ,\ 126.5^\circ}$。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2021-mj33-q5"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2021/2021/9709_s21_qp_33.pdf` and matching `9709_s21_ms_33.pdf`.</div>
:::

### Reciprocal identities and double-angle equations

::: {.question-card #trig-2022-mj31-q3}
### Example 8 · Cotangent double angle · 9709/31/M/J/22 Q3
<span class="tag">cot</span><span class="tag">double angle</span>

Solve the equation $2\cot2x+3\cot x=5$, for $0^\circ<x<180^\circ$. **[6]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

令 $t=\cot x$。由

$$
\cot2x=\frac{\cot^2x-1}{2\cot x}=\frac{t^2-1}{2t},
$$

原方程变为

$$
2\left(\frac{t^2-1}{2t}\right)+3t=5.
$$

乘以 $t$ 并整理：

$$
t^2-1+3t^2=5t
\Longrightarrow
4t^2-5t-1=0.
$$

因此

$$
t=\frac{5\pm\sqrt{41}}8.
$$

代回 $t=\cot x$，并按 $0^\circ<x<180^\circ$ 的 quadrant sign 检查，得到

$$
\boxed{x=35.1^\circ,\ 99.9^\circ}.
$$
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2022-mj31-q3"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2022/2022/9709_s22_qp_31.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2022-mj32-q2}
### Example 9 · Cosine double angle · 9709/32/M/J/22 Q2
<span class="tag">cos double angle</span><span class="tag">quadratic</span>

Solve the equation $3\cos2\theta=3\cos\theta+2$, for $0^\circ\le\theta\le360^\circ$. **[5]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

令 $c=\cos\theta$，使用 $\cos2\theta=2c^2-1$：

$$
3(2c^2-1)=3c+2
\Longrightarrow
6c^2-3c-5=0.
$$

解得

$$
c=\frac{3\pm\sqrt{129}}{12}.
$$

其中 $\frac{3+\sqrt{129}}{12}>1$，不是 cosine 的可能值，舍去；保留

$$
\cos\theta=\frac{3-\sqrt{129}}{12}=-0.69648... .
$$

在第二、三象限：

$$
\theta=\cos^{-1}(-0.69648...)=134.146...^\circ,
$$

以及 $360^\circ-134.146...^\circ=225.854...^\circ$。

答案为 $\boxed{\theta=134.1^\circ,\ 225.9^\circ}$。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2022-mj32-q2"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2022/2022/9709_s22_qp_32.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2022-on31-q4}
### Example 10 · Tangent addition and cotangent · 9709/31/O/N/22 Q4
<span class="tag">tan addition</span><span class="tag">quadratic</span>

Solve the equation $\tan(x+45^\circ)=2\cot x$ for $0^\circ<x<180^\circ$. **[5]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

令 $t=\tan x$。由 $\tan45^\circ=1$：

$$
\frac{t+1}{1-t}=\frac2t.
$$

交叉相乘并整理：

$$
t(t+1)=2(1-t)
\Longrightarrow
t^2+3t-2=0.
$$

所以

$$
t=\frac{-3\pm\sqrt{17}}2.
$$

两个根分别给出第一象限和第三象限的解：

$$
x=\tan^{-1}(0.56155...)=29.3165...^\circ,
$$

$$
x=180^\circ+\tan^{-1}(-3.56155...)=105.6835...^\circ.
$$

因此 $\boxed{x=29.3^\circ,\ 105.7^\circ}$。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2022-on31-q4"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2022/2022/9709_w22_qp_31.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2022-on31-q6}
### Example 11 · Identity and quartic reduction · 9709/31/O/N/22 Q6
<span class="tag">identity</span><span class="tag">quadratic</span>

(a) Prove the identity $\cos4\theta+4\cos2\theta+3\equiv8\cos^4\theta$.

(b) Hence solve the equation $\cos4\theta+4\cos2\theta=4$ for $0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$. **[7]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

(a) 令 $u=\cos2\theta$。由 $\cos4\theta=2\cos^22\theta-1$，

$$
\cos4\theta+4\cos2\theta+3
=(2u^2-1)+4u+3
=2(u+1)^2.
$$

而 $u+1=\cos2\theta+1=2\cos^2\theta$，所以

$$
2(u+1)^2=2(2\cos^2\theta)^2=8\cos^4\theta.
$$

这就证明了题目的 identity。

(b) 由 (a)，原方程加 3 后为

$$
8\cos^4\theta=7
\Longrightarrow
\cos^2\theta=\left(\frac78\right)^{1/2}.
$$

故

$$
\cos\theta=\pm\left(\frac78\right)^{1/4}.
$$

在 $0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$ 内，

$$
\theta=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac78\right)^{1/4}=14.722...^\circ
$$

或其补角 $180^\circ-14.722...^\circ=165.278...^\circ$。

答案为 $\boxed{\theta=14.7^\circ,\ 165.3^\circ}$。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2022-on31-q6"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2022/2022/9709_w22_qp_31.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

### Mixed R-form and identity practice

::: {.question-card #trig-2023-mj32-q6}
### Example 12 · R-form in radians · 9709/32/M/J/23 Q6
<span class="tag">R-form</span><span class="tag">radians</span>

(a) Express $5\sin\theta+12\cos\theta$ in the form $R\cos(\theta-\alpha)$, where $R>0$ and $0<\alpha<\frac12\pi$. State the exact value of $R$ and give $\alpha$ correct to 2 decimal places.

(b) Hence solve the equation $5\sin2x+12\cos2x=6$ for $0\le x\le\pi$. **[7]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

由

$$
R\cos(\theta-\alpha)=R\cos\alpha\cos\theta+R\sin\alpha\sin\theta,
$$

比较系数得 $R\cos\alpha=12$、$R\sin\alpha=5$，所以

$$
\boxed{R=13},\qquad \boxed{\alpha=\tan^{-1}(5/12)=0.39\text{ rad}}.
$$

令 $u=2x$，则 $0\le u\le2\pi$，方程为

$$
13\cos(u-\alpha)=6.
$$

设 $\beta=\cos^{-1}(6/13)=1.09107...$。在 $0\le u\le2\pi$ 内，

$$
u-\alpha=\beta\quad\text{或}\quad u-\alpha=2\pi-\beta.
$$

故

$$
x=\frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}=0.74293...,
\qquad
x=\frac{\alpha+2\pi-\beta}{2}=2.79345... .
$$

答案为 $\boxed{x=0.743,\ 2.793}$ radians。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2023-mj32-q6"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2023/2023/9709_m23_qp_32.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2023-mj31-q4}
### Example 13 · Double-angle rearrangement · 9709/31/M/J/23 Q4
<span class="tag">double angle</span><span class="tag">tan</span>

(a) Show that the equation $\sin2\theta+\cos2\theta=2\sin^2\theta$ can be expressed in the form

$$
\cos^2\theta+2\sin\theta\cos\theta-3\sin^2\theta=0.
$$

(b) Hence solve the equation $\sin2\theta+\cos2\theta=2\sin^2\theta$ for $0^\circ<\theta<180^\circ$. **[7]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

使用 $\sin2\theta=2\sin\theta\cos\theta$ 及 $\cos2\theta=\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta$：

$$
2\sin\theta\cos\theta+\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta=2\sin^2\theta,
$$

即

$$
\cos^2\theta+2\sin\theta\cos\theta-3\sin^2\theta=0.
$$

由于区间内 $\cos\theta=0$ 的 $\theta=90^\circ$ 不满足原式，除以 $\cos^2\theta$，令 $t=\tan\theta$：

$$
1+2t-3t^2=0
\Longrightarrow
(t-1)(3t+1)=0.
$$

因此 $t=1$ 或 $t=-1/3$，给出

$$
\boxed{\theta=45^\circ,\ 161.6^\circ}.
$$
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2023-mj31-q4"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2023/2023/9709_s23_qp_31.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2023-mj32-q2}
### Example 14 · Half-angle substitution · 9709/32/M/J/23 Q2
<span class="tag">double angle</span><span class="tag">radians</span>

Solve the equation $2\cos x-\cos\frac12x=1$ for $0\le x\le2\pi$. **[5]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

令 $u=x/2$，则 $x=2u$ 且 $0\le u\le\pi$。原式变为

$$
2\cos2u-\cos u=1.
$$

令 $c=\cos u$，用 $\cos2u=2c^2-1$：

$$
2(2c^2-1)-c=1
\Longrightarrow
4c^2-c-3=0
\Longrightarrow
(4c+3)(c-1)=0.
$$

根 $c=1$ 或 $c=-3/4$ 都在 cosine 的值域内。故

$$
u=0\quad\text{or}\quad u=\cos^{-1}(-3/4),
$$

所以

$$
\boxed{x=0,\quad x=2\cos^{-1}(-3/4)=4.838\text{ rad}}.
$$
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2023-mj32-q2"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2023/2023/9709_s23_qp_32.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2023-mj33-q6}
### Example 15 · Shifted cosine R-form · 9709/33/M/J/23 Q6
<span class="tag">R-form</span><span class="tag">compound angle</span>

(a) Express $3\cos x+2\cos(x-60^\circ)$ in the form $R\cos(x-\phi)$, where $R>0$ and $0^\circ<\phi<90^\circ$. State the exact value of $R$ and give $\phi$ correct to 2 decimal places.

(b) Hence solve the equation $3\cos2\theta+2\cos(2\theta-60^\circ)=2.5$ for $0^\circ<\theta<180^\circ$. **[8]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

先展开：

$$
2\cos(x-60^\circ)=2\left(\frac12\cos x+\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\sin x\right)=\cos x+\sqrt3\sin x.
$$

所以原式为 $4\cos x+\sqrt3\sin x$。写成 $R\cos(x-\phi)$：

$$
R\cos\phi=4,\qquad R\sin\phi=\sqrt3,
$$

从而

$$
\boxed{R=\sqrt{19}},\qquad
\boxed{\phi=\tan^{-1}(\sqrt3/4)=23.41^\circ}.
$$

(b) 令 $u=2\theta$，则 $0^\circ<u<360^\circ$：

$$
\sqrt{19}\cos(u-\phi)=2.5.
$$

设 $\beta=\cos^{-1}(2.5/\sqrt{19})=55.003^\circ$。因此

$$
u=\phi+\beta=78.416^\circ
\quad\text{or}\quad
u=\phi+360^\circ-\beta=328.410^\circ.
$$

所以

$$
\boxed{\theta=39.2^\circ,\ 164.2^\circ}.
$$
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2023-mj33-q6"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2023/2023/9709_s23_qp_33.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

### 2024 Paper 3 identities and R-form

::: {.question-card #trig-2024-fm32-q8}
### Example 16 · R-form with radians · 9709/32/F/M/24 Q8
<span class="tag">R-form</span><span class="tag">radians</span>

(a) Express $3\sin x+2\sqrt2\cos\left(x+\frac14\pi\right)$ in the form $R\sin(x+\alpha)$, where $R>0$ and $0<\alpha<\frac12\pi$. State the exact value of $R$ and give $\alpha$ correct to 3 decimal places.

(b) Hence solve the equation

$$
6\sin\frac12\theta+4\sqrt2\cos\left(\frac12\theta+\frac14\pi\right)=3
$$

for $-4\pi<\theta<4\pi$. **[9]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

(a) 因为

$$
2\sqrt2\cos\left(x+\frac\pi4\right)=2(\cos x-\sin x)，
$$

所以表达式为 $\sin x+2\cos x$。比较 $R\sin(x+\alpha)$ 的系数：

$$
R\cos\alpha=1,\qquad R\sin\alpha=2.
$$

因此

$$
\boxed{R=\sqrt5},\qquad \boxed{\alpha=\tan^{-1}2=1.107\text{ rad}}.
$$

(b) 令 $u=\theta/2$。同样的展开给出

$$
6\sin u+4\sqrt2\cos\left(u+\frac\pi4\right)=2\sin u+4\cos u
=2\sqrt5\sin(u+\alpha).
$$

所以

$$
\sin(u+\alpha)=\frac3{2\sqrt5}.
$$

设 $\beta=\sin^{-1}(3/(2\sqrt5))=0.735314...$，且 $-2\pi<u<2\pi$。由

$$
u+\alpha=\beta+2k\pi
\quad\text{or}\quad
u+\alpha=\pi-\beta+2k\pi
$$

筛选区间后，$\theta=2u$ 为

$$
\boxed{\theta=-9.968,\ -0.744,\ 2.598,\ 11.823}\quad\text{radians}.
$$

按题目要求可写为 $\boxed{-9.97,\ -0.744,\ 2.60,\ 11.8}$。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2024-fm32-q8"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2024/2024/A-Level-CAIE数学QP-202403-Mathematics-P32-A-Level题库大全小程序.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2024-mj32-q7}
### Example 17 · Difference of fourth powers · 9709/32/M/J/24 Q7(a)
<span class="tag">identity</span><span class="tag">double angle</span>

Show that $\cos^4\theta-\sin^4\theta\equiv\cos2\theta$. **[3]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

使用 difference of squares：

$$
\cos^4\theta-\sin^4\theta
=(\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta)(\cos^2\theta+\sin^2\theta).
$$

由 $\cos^2\theta+\sin^2\theta=1$ 以及 $\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta=\cos2\theta$，得到

$$
\boxed{\cos^4\theta-\sin^4\theta\equiv\cos2\theta}.
$$
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2024-mj32-q7"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2024/2024/A-Level-CAIE数学QP-202406-Mathematics-P32-A-Level题库大全小程序.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2024-on31-q4}
### Example 18 · Secant and tangent identity · 9709/31/O/N/24 Q4
<span class="tag">sec</span><span class="tag">quartic</span>

(a) Show that $\sec^4\theta-\tan^4\theta=1+2\tan^2\theta$.

(b) Hence or otherwise solve the equation

$$
\sec^4(2\alpha)-\tan^4(2\alpha)=2\tan^2(2\alpha)\sec^2(2\alpha)
$$

for $0^\circ\le\alpha\le180^\circ$. **[8]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

(a)

$$
\sec^4\theta-\tan^4\theta
=(\sec^2\theta-\tan^2\theta)(\sec^2\theta+\tan^2\theta).
$$

由 $\sec^2\theta-\tan^2\theta=1$，且 $\sec^2\theta=1+\tan^2\theta$，

$$
\sec^4\theta-\tan^4\theta=1(1+2\tan^2\theta).
$$

(b) 令 $t=\tan2\alpha$。左边由 (a) 为 $2+2t^2$，右边为

$$
2t^2\sec^2(2\alpha)=2t^2(1+t^2).
$$

所以

$$
2+2t^2=2t^2+2t^4
\Longrightarrow t^4=1
\Longrightarrow t=\pm1.
$$

因为 $0^\circ\le2\alpha\le360^\circ$，所以 $2\alpha=45^\circ,135^\circ,225^\circ,315^\circ$，从而

$$
\boxed{\alpha=22.5^\circ,\ 67.5^\circ,\ 112.5^\circ,\ 157.5^\circ}.
$$
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2024-on31-q4"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2024/2024/A-Level-CAIE数学QP-202410-Mathematics-P31-A-Level题库大全小程序.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2024-on33-q5}
### Example 19 · Identity followed by quadratic · 9709/33/O/N/24 Q5
<span class="tag">identity</span><span class="tag">cos double angle</span>

(a) Show that

$$
\cos^4\alpha-\sin^4\alpha-4\sin^2\alpha\cos^2\alpha
\equiv\cos^22\alpha+\cos2\alpha-1.
$$

(b) Solve the equation $\cos^4\alpha-\sin^4\alpha=4\sin^2\alpha\cos^2\alpha$ for $0^\circ\le\alpha\le180^\circ$. **[6]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

(a) 先使用 Example 17 的恒等式：

$$
\cos^4\alpha-\sin^4\alpha=\cos2\alpha,
$$

以及

$$
4\sin^2\alpha\cos^2\alpha=(2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha)^2=\sin^22\alpha.
$$

因此

$$
\cos2\alpha-\sin^22\alpha
=\cos2\alpha-(1-\cos^22\alpha)
=\cos^22\alpha+\cos2\alpha-1.
$$

(b) 将原方程移到左边并用 (a)：

$$
\cos^22\alpha+\cos2\alpha-1=0.
$$

令 $u=\cos2\alpha$，则 $u^2+u-1=0$，故

$$
u=\frac{-1\pm\sqrt5}{2}.
$$

负根小于 $-1$，舍去，保留 $u=(\sqrt5-1)/2$。于是

$$
2\alpha=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt5-1}{2}\right)
\quad\text{or}\quad
360^\circ-\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt5-1}{2}\right).
$$

所以 $\boxed{\alpha=25.9^\circ,\ 154.1^\circ}$。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2024-on33-q5"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2024/2024/A-Level-CAIE数学QP-202410-Mathematics-P33-A-Level题库大全小程序.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.question-card #trig-2022-on32-q4}
### Example 20 · R-form equation · 9709/32/O/N/22 Q4
<span class="tag">R-form</span><span class="tag">degrees</span>

(a) Express $4\cos x-\sin x$ in the form $R\cos(x+\phi)$, where $R>0$ and $0^\circ<\phi<90^\circ$.

(b) Hence solve the equation $4\cos2x-\sin2x=3$ for $0^\circ<x<180^\circ$. **[7]**

<details class="answer-panel"><summary>Show detailed mark scheme answer</summary>

(a) 展开 $R\cos(x+\phi)=R\cos\phi\cos x-R\sin\phi\sin x$，比较系数得

$$
R\cos\phi=4,\qquad R\sin\phi=1.
$$

所以

$$
\boxed{R=\sqrt{17}},\qquad \boxed{\phi=\tan^{-1}(1/4)=14.036^\circ}.
$$

(b) 令 $u=2x$，则 $0^\circ<u<360^\circ$：

$$
\sqrt{17}\cos(u+\phi)=3.
$$

令 $\beta=\cos^{-1}(3/\sqrt{17})=42.977...^\circ$。由于 $u+\phi$ 的范围为 $14.036^\circ<u+\phi<374.036^\circ$，两个有效角为

$$
u+\phi=\beta
\quad\text{或}\quad
u+\phi=360^\circ-\beta.
$$

因此

$$
x=\frac{\beta-\phi}{2}=14.470...^\circ,
\qquad
x=\frac{360^\circ-\beta-\phi}{2}=151.493...^\circ.
$$

答案为 $\boxed{x=14.5^\circ,\ 151.5^\circ}$。
</details>
<label class="done-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-progress="trig-2022-on32-q4"> Completed</label>
<div class="source-line"><strong>Source:</strong> `PastPaper/2022/2022/9709_s22_qp_32.pdf` and matching mark scheme.</div>
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Exam checklist

1. 先确认题目用的是 degrees 还是 radians，并保持 calculator mode 一致。
2. 用 $R$-form 时先比较 coefficients，再求 $R$ 和 $\alpha$，不要只凭图像猜角度。
3. 把三角方程化成 quadratic 后，检查 roots 是否在 $[-1,1]$（若是 sine/cosine）或是否违反原式 domain。
4. 用 inverse trig 得到 principal value 后，按 quadrant、period 和题目 interval 补齐全部答案。
5. 若除以 $\sin\theta$、$\cos\theta$ 或 $\tan\theta$，要先检查被除数为零的情况，避免漏解。
:::
